summary: Spec fidelity (F7 acceptance: a command writing to an unwritable target is exit 2 with a precondition code and changes nothing): only the commands the CHANGELOG lists check up front. With `.canon` read-only I verified exit 2 WRITE_UNAVAILABLE and no change for change new, feature new, scenario new, divergence add, finding add, evidence add, gate install-hooks, policy approve and review scenario. But `subject new` and `subject move` exit 1 WRITE_FAILED (message `io: Permission denied (os error 13)`, no path), `inventory sync` exit 1 INVENTORY_FAILED, `ingest plans` exit 1 INGEST_FAILED and `report build` exit 1 REPORT_FAILED, each with nothing changed. Blast radius: every other writer not in the CHANGELOG list (ingest records/sessions, dispatch, strategy, context-pack, prompt, artifacts store, plugin sync) is untested; the bound test covers only `gate install-hooks`.
